daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving thoughtful and intentional. The cosmos is inviting you to slow down and really listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Trust the whispers.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, today's energy is about authenticity. Someone might show up differently than expected—be open to it. Real connection happens when you drop the mask.
daily.career: This is a solid day to advocate for yourself quietly. You don't need to be loud; your ideas have weight. Channel that Libra diplomacy into something concrete and watch doors respond.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance, not extremes. A mix of movement and rest hits different today. Hydrate, touch grass if you can, and give yourself permission to exist without optimizing everything.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is calling you to trust your gut more than usual, Libra. Venus is whispering that balance doesn't mean perfection—it means knowing when to lean in and when to step back. Mercury's got your back for meaningful conversations.
weekly.love: Someone's been observing you from the sidelines, and this week gives you permission to notice them back. If you're coupled up, this is a low-key moment to remind your person why you chose them. No grand gestures needed, just presence.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now, and people are listening. This is the week to share that project you've been sitting on or pitch that thing you've been nervous about. The energy supports visibility and authentic self-expression at work.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Skip the intensity if it doesn't feel aligned—walks, stretching, and good sleep are your main characters. Pay attention to what your system is actually craving rather than forcing routines that drain you.
